bib.title: Bootstrap Your Own Latent: A New Approach to Self-Supervised Learning
bib.venue: preprint (arXiv:2006.07733v3, 10 Sep 2020; PDF names no venue)

question: Can a self-supervised image representation reach state-of-the-art quality without negative pairs?
hypothesis: A predictor on the online network plus a slow moving-average target network prevents collapse and allows learning by predicting the target's representation of another view.
contributions: BYOL, a self-supervised representation method without negative pairs, state of the art under ImageNet linear evaluation
Learned representation outperforms the state of the art on semi-supervised and transfer benchmarks
More resilient than contrastive counterparts to batch size and augmentation set changes

method.summary: Online network (encoder f, projector g, predictor q) regresses the l2-normalised target projection of a second augmented view; target weights are an EMA of online weights, with stop-gradient and a symmetrised loss. Pretrained on ImageNet with ResNets and evaluated by linear probe, fine-tuning and transfer.

datasets.name: ImageNet ILSVRC-2012
datasets.preprocessing: SimCLR-style augmentations; random crop area 8%-100%, aspect 3/4-4/3, resize 224x224 bicubic; per-channel mean/std normalisation

datasets.name: 12 transfer classification sets (Food101, CIFAR-10/100, Birdsnap, SUN397, Cars, Aircraft, VOC2007, DTD, Pets, Caltech-101, Flowers)
datasets.split: official test, else validation as test with held-out val

datasets.name: VOC2012 seg / VOC2007 det / NYU v2 depth
datasets.size: VOC2012 train_aug 10582, val 1449; NYU test 654 images

models.name: BYOL ResNet-50 (1x) v1
models.architecture: ResNet-50 encoder (2048-d); projector MLP 4096 hidden + BN + ReLU + 256 out; predictor same architecture as projector; no BN on MLP output

training.objective: MSE between l2-normalised prediction and target projection, symmetrised: L = ||q(z)-z'||^2 = 2-2<q(z),z'>/(|q(z)||z'|)
training.optimizer: LARS (beta 0.9, trust coef 1e-3), biases and BN excluded from adaption and weight decay
training.batch_size: 4096 (512 TPU v3 cores); 512 variant on 64 cores
training.steps: inferred: int(1000*1281167/4096) from Appendix J HPS
training.regularisation: EMA target tau from 0.996 to 1 by cosine: tau = 1-(1-tau_base)(cos(pi k/K)+1)/2; ablations tau_base 0.99, lr 0.3
training.hardware: 512 Cloud TPU v3 cores (64 cores for ablations)
training.compute: ~8 hours for ResNet-50 (1x) at batch 4096; ~4 days at batch 512 on 64 cores
training.seeds: ablations: 3 seeds averaged; Appendix J code seed=1337; main results single run, no variance reported

other.augmentations: Table 6: blur p 1.0 (T) / 0.1 (T'), solarize p 0.0 / 0.2; jitter p 0.8 with max brightness 0.4, contrast 0.4, saturation 0.2, hue 0.1; grayscale 0.2; flip 0.5
other.linear_eval: SGD Nesterov 80 epochs, batch 1024, momentum 0.9, no weight decay, lr swept {0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1,0.05}
other.transfer_ft: SGD Nesterov 20000 steps batch 256, 7 lr in 1e-4..0.1, 7 wd in 1e-6..1e-3
other.transfer_linear: L-BFGS logistic regression, 45 l2 values in 1e-6..1e5
other.detection: Faster R-CNN R50-C4, async SGD 9 workers, 1.5M steps, lr 1e-3

inference.samples: ablations averaged over 3 seeds; half-difference of best/worst reported when >0.25

other.eval_crop: resize shorter side 256 bicubic, 224 center crop

metrics.name: top-1/top-5 accuracy
metrics.definition: linear classifier on frozen representation; also semi-supervised fine-tune

metrics.name: mIoU / AP50 / depth pct<1.25n, rms, rel

eval.protocol: Ablations at 300 epochs on 64 TPU v3, 3 seeds; main results from one 1000-epoch run each; hyperparameters picked on 10009-image local validation split

limits: No proof why collapse is avoided; authors only hypothesise, assuming an optimal predictor and dropping normalisation/symmetrisation (Sec 3.2)
BYOL dynamics still admit undesirable equilibria; authors say they did not observe them
Depends on vision-specific augmentations; other modalities need new ones (Conclusion)
BN stays in encoder and heads; never tested without batch statistics
Ablations run at 300 epochs with authors' own SimCLR reproduction; main results have no seeds or variance
RMS depth error worse than several baselines
